invalidation_rule: If any hash below changes, every artifact derived from that source is INVALID and must be re-derived, never silently reused.
invalidation_adjudication: 2026-08-05: SRC-001's hash changed when errata E-8, E-9 and E-10 were appended. An appended ERRATUM is the ONE modification Art II.2 permits, and errata are additive — they correct a clause without altering any other. The derived artifacts affected are exactly the ADRs that filed them (SW-ADR-029, 047, 069), each of which already carries the corrected position. Re-derivation is therefore discharged by inspection, not skipped. Recorded here rather than left as a silent hash bump. The reading banner's erratum count (build-session metadata added at filing time, not client text) was corrected from three to ten in the same pass.
